followup.environment: anypoc-freetype Docker image (Ubuntu 22.04, clang, cmake, git, /opt/freetype full history including intro/parent/fix commits). No custom Dockerfile needed. Build/run done in an ephemeral --rm container (--cpus=8 --memory=24g, timeout 1750s). setup_i386_toolchain.sh unpacked libc6-dev-i386 via apt inside the container to build a local i386 sysroot (clang -m32 --sysroot=...), because the target arithmetic type `Long` (C `long`) in src/raster/ftraster.c is 64-bit on x86_64 -- the overflow (~2.35e9) only leaves the signed range at 32 bits, i.e. this is inherently an i386-only reproduction (OSS-Fuzz builds FreeType for both x86_64 and i386; this is the i386 target). Pre-2013 revisions (parent/intro) have no CMakeLists.txt so amalgamation files were hand-compiled with clang -m32 -fsanitize=address,signed-integer-overflow; the two later revisions (fix/fix^) used CMake -DBUILD_SHARED_LIBS=OFF with the same sanitizer flags.
